description: Placeholder values hiding as data: caller-declared sentinels and likely candidates — Scans columns of values for sentinels. Values you declare in a dictionary (for example -1 means unknown in column age) are reported as asserted hits with their row paths. Other values that look like missing-data markers are reported separately as candidates, never asserted: the pandas default NA strings, spreadsheet error values, whitespace-only text, placeholder words, zero and epoch dates, fixed

items.description: A cell: string, number, boolean or null.

column.description: Limit the entry to this column; omit for all columns.

value.description: The sentinel value (string, number or boolean); matched by type and value.

name: sentinel-values
